model: EASYLAB TCU3 room supply/extract controller without room management function (EM-BAC-MOD-01, BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: TROX EASYLAB TCU3 controllers set up as room supply/extract controller without room management function, fitted with the EM-BAC-MOD-01 expansion module.
summary: TROX EASYLAB lab and room airflow controllers connect to BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU) through the EM-BAC-MOD-01 expansion module. This is TROX's EDE file for the room supply/extract controller without room management function (order code LAB / CLR): 52 value objects (25 AV, 25 BV, 2 MV). The MS/TP module has a much smaller object set than the EM-IP (BACnet IP) module, and some instance numbers differ.
notes: The module holds the objects of all applications; objects outside this application stay unused.
Units come from the EDE unit-code column; airflows are in l/s.
MV 1 COVU-Mode (MS/TP module only) sets how unsolicited COV notifications go out: 1 none, 2 local MS/TP broadcast, 3 global broadcast.

integration.summary: This application takes no mode preset over BACnet; the BMS mainly reads airflow, damper and alarm values. Read MV 3 ModeAct, AV 2 VolflowAct, AV 3 VolTotalExh, BV 1 LocalAlarm.

minimum_points.name: ModeAct
minimum_points.why: Current operating mode of this controller

integration.remote_sensors: AV 22 VolflowExh and AV 23 VolflowSup let the BMS feed extract and supply airflows of other equipment into the room balance.
setup: Default device instance is 32900 plus the network address set on hex switches X/Y.
MS/TP baud rate (9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800) is set on DIP switches 2 and 3; DIP 1 selects EASYLAB TCU3 or another controller.
Max_Master defaults to 127 and Max_Info_Frames to 1.
gotchas: If the network interface fails the airflow controller keeps controlling; only data exchange with the BMS stops.
